title: Agent addendum frontmatter
description: Frontmatter of a runtime addendum: values that overlay agent.md for one runtime.

description.description: One line on what the agent does.

status.description: Only an active agent runs and takes work. Default active.

can_claim.description: Task types the role takes from the queue; `*` for any.

projects.description: Projects the agent works on; `*` for any.

model.description: Model for the agent's runs; `default` takes the runtime's.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for the agent's runs.

mcp.description: MCP server names the role may use.

kb.description: Learn-note topics (`kb/<topic>/`) the agent reads before it works.

files.description: Files or folders the agent reads before it works, relative to the project.

style.description: How the agent writes: tone, format, words to use and avoid.

runtimes.description: Overrides per runtime; a machine setting for the agent still wins.

writes.description: The role changes files. A machine's `swarmupd.roles.<role>.writes` wins; this wins over `swarm.yaml`.

scorers.description: Scorers that judge the agent’s work.

body.description: How this file's body applies: after the role's body (append, the default) or instead of it.

model.description: Model for this runtime's runs of the agent.

effort.description: Reasoning effort for this runtime's runs of the agent.
